text: Effects serve the chosen direction; they do not establish a default material or lighting style.

Use native paints/geometry for simple gradients, strokes and shadows, preserving editability. Generate texture or complex imagery only when that component calls for it; references.md owns that decision.

Supported examples: shadow(#000000, o(0.12), y(8), blur(24)); fill(linear(135, stop($surface.page,0), stop($surface.brand,1))); stroke(#000000, 1); rd(16). Read grammar.md and colors.md for argument forms.
An unsupported effect must become a named gap, not an invented property or a flattened complete ad. Inspect the final composite for contrast and crop after applying effects.
